summary: Build a USB-powered competition battery-balancing daughterboard for a two-series-cell Li-ion pack. Monitor each cell independently and bleed the higher-voltage cell at 50 mA above 4.10 V; stop balancing below 4.05 V. Support 3.0–4.2 V per cell. Do not replace the two-cell pack with a single cell or substitute pack-only voltage monitoring. Charging is external and is not part of this board.
title: Two-cell battery balancing daughterboard
